citations.review_text:
THIS CONTAINS SPOILERS!!!!!!!!!!!!

This is the best horror game I have ever played. I absolutely love when games incorporate the games files into the game itself so that was super fun, and I also thought that the poems were a clever way to foreshadow and express what the characters are feeling. I wished that we could've learned more about what the characters actually do, for example, it felt like we barely got to even see how Natsuki's dad is abusing her (well obviously I know why we didn't see any of it, not only is it too heavy but it would 100% break the immersion. I guess I just wish we could've gotten more details about it so we could understand Natsuki better). I should also mention that the game devs did an amazing job with setting the atmosphere to make me feel on edge even if nothing was happening yet. In my opinion, they really knew how to unsettle you. My favorite way they did this was when, even if it was just one note, they changed the background music to be more unsettling, the music REALLY helps set the mood throughout the whole game and the whole soundtrack is fire. I thought it was especially terrifying when Yuri had human-like eyes, that was a particularly scary part of the game that i thought added so much because Monika says stuff like "It kinda feel like were the only real people here right? well thats because none of my friends are real lmao" and then to give Yuri so much human emotion and to dive into the "insane" side of Yuri so deeply was really an awesome choice. Soooo yeah, all in all, I'd love to learn molre about how like theres a religious camp that Yuri is stuck in??? That sounds cool asf :P Also does Yuri like cutting herself so much because it's reminiscent of her getting her limbs cut off? idk...

Just Monika.

spoiler warning before I begin...




if I'm being honest I was really sceptical of even downloading this game, my mate has been telling me to play this game for maybe a year or so and I've always pushed it away because its anime and just women, makes me seem like a saddo (no offence to people who do play anime games)

but i thought "lets just give it a try" 
i started the game off already feeling kind of off put by the way the characters are drawn, but after a while i just got use to it, i then slow began noticing the slight slip ups within some characters dialog, which made me feel a little bit uneasy, but once again, pushed it past believing the game would just keep going like normal, which it did, for a time, then i got to the part where Sayori confesses her love for the protagonist, i politely put down her confession in the nicest way the game allows.
the next day monika is the first one to the club, she mentions stuff that her character SHOULD NOT KNOW, thats when truely knew this game was different, mentioned something about leaving sayori hanging around all morning, the game makes you run to sayoris house... now there is one line that will forever remind me of this game

"I gently open the door..." 

i wont continue ranting about the rest, but this game is something else, how deep the lore goes is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ insane to me, all of the files, the secret messages within said files, the distorted photo, the "secret" poems that you get given throughout the game, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ man this game is super twisted, but in a good way
100/10 would recomend and would definitely play again to see if there are alternate ending for different characters

a phenomenal game that plays with you psychologically and itself ([spoiler]game is messing with its' own files and even has messages hidden in some of them![/spoiler]). 
most "psychological" "horrors" rush the scary part, this game does it properly and makes you comfortable before doing a complete 180 degrees on you.

it's surprising that this game is free, and i'm more than happy to buy the Plus version in the future!
(my friend made me play this game and we decided to read text out loud, that was a great way to make me better at english pronunciation)

A nice 3-ish hour VN filled with jokes and cute characters.


Other than that, the horror is very well executed, theres parts where you think there might be a jumpscare, but there isnt,  
the deletion of the .chr files is cool! theres only really 2 jumpscares, but all the other horror parts, are really just unnerving, which is good!
